messages:
Gloria: quick heads-up — seeing a repeat/ghost token pattern after short->long handoff on the int8 bridge bringup. Repro on long_convo_goldset_v2, only on quantized build.
Liam: can you describe the failure mode (symptoms + minimal repro)?
Gloria: symptoms: after priming with ~400 tokens then continuing to >=2048 the model starts spitting repeated small words (e.g. 'the the the') then drifts off topic. Not observed on fp16 or on the non-rotary variants. Happens on both dedicated and local docker.
Gloria: repro command I used:
```
python tests/repro_kv.py --model redwood-bridge-int8 --prompt tests/long_convo/conv_045.txt --max_new_tokens 512 --seed 42 --kv-debug
```
Gloria: short excerpt of the generated sequence (truncated):
```
... and then the the the the the the the the
```
Gloria: kv debug prints show an index mismatch when we do the post-handoff stitch: expected kv_len=2048, got 2036, then we see a shift +12 applied during map_kv_to_shards.
Liam: hmm. Could be an off-by-one in prefill-to-stream index mapping, or a RoPE angle scaling mismatch after quantization. Any evidence pointing one way?
Owen: my hypothesis: the quantization step used a slightly different rotary scaling multiplier (we recently added a tiny numeric accel: `rotary_scale = 1.007` for training sim). runtime still assumes `1.0`. At long sequences that scales angles enough to shift phase and effectively move kv indexes when we reconstruct keys.
Gloria: interesting — I can dump the raw rotary angles from fp16 vs int8 to compare. Quick check I ran locally showed tiny diffs but cumulative drift by token 2048.
Owen: quick diagnostic snippet to run on a single layer:
```python
# quick check
angles_fp16 = load_angles('fp16_angles.npz')
angles_int8 = load_angles('int8_angles.npz')
print((angles_int8[:16] / angles_fp16[:16]).mean())
```
Owen: if that mean != 1.0 (by >1e-3) that's already suspicious.
Liam: can you attach the trace? Put the full run trace in internal tracing so we can inspect kernel/layer boundaries.
Gloria: trace uploaded: <https://internal.traces/run-3776543210|trace-3776543210> — includes the debug KV map, layer-level angle dumps, and the model binary used.
quant-bot: auto-analysis: long-context regression flagged. Detected kv_index_shift:+12 at seq_boundary=2048 for model redwood-bridge-int8 in test long_convo_goldset_v2 (pPLM delta +0.18, em_drop 4.2%).
Nina: can we bisect? Which commits are likely candidates?
Gloria: bisect window: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/compare/9c1f2a..d4b2c7 — 9c1f2a is last good fp16 build, d4b2c7 is where the int8 conversion & rotary micro-optim landed.
Owen: easy mitigation: add a compatibility path in the quant loader to rescale rotary angles back to baseline during load. I'll try a small patch to multiply angles by 1.0/1.007 for int8 artifacts and run the smoke.
Gloria: running the patched loader now locally (will push logs).
Gloria: kernel log snippet after patched load:
```
[kv_map] prefill_len=400 handoff_seq=2048 mapped=2048 check_ok=true
[layer-10] angle_scale: 1.0002 -> rescaled
```
Gloria: generation looks much better so far, repeats gone in this sample. Need larger sweep.
Liam: good. Can you run a canary suite: 50 samples from long_convo_goldset_v2 and the official long-context regression harness? If stable, let's roll to dedicated canary.
Nina: I'll queue a dedicated canary on the infra side once you give the green. Please include both int8-bridge and fp16 baselines for comparison.
Gloria: started canary job: https://ci.internal/canary/3776543210-ghostfix — currently running 50 samples, will post results.
quant-bot: note — also recommend running the 'rotary-precision-check' eval across seeds [1,2,3] and lengths [1024,2048,4096]. I scheduled that automatically.
Owen: if this patch holds, we should add a loader-time consistency assert to catch angle drifts > 5e-4 and fail heavyweight quant loads in CI.
Liam: agree. Also add a small unit that reconstructs `kv_index` mapping sanity at known boundaries to catch any off-by-n regressions.
Gloria: can everyone @review the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1287 (loader rescale + kv-sanity unit).
Nina: @Gloria :eyes: I'll watch infra results. If canary passes, I'll promote to canary-dedicated and add an alert to rollback if pPLM delta > 0.1.
Gloria: thanks — will follow up with the sweep results.
Liam: thanks team. Great quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
quant-bot: regression-suite finished (quick pass): int8-bridge post-patch pPLM delta 0.02 vs fp16 baseline, no repeat patterns in 50 samples.
Gloria: posting final artifacts to the ticket: https://tickets.internal/INFR-1129 — logs, traces, and the failing sample set attached.
Owen: I'll prep a small hotfix deploy for canary later today.
Nina: marking incident -> monitoring for 48h after rollout.
Gloria: will keep monitoring metrics. Thanks all.
